limitations: 功能摘要根据作者固定版本材料归纳，不是逐字引文或独立效果验证。

limitations: 四材料摘要/固定SOURCE一致；核npm launcher/Cargo版本、Rust stdio/MCP/锁/安全策略、语义缓存/策略/代表macOS AX真实动作与回执、CDP click/evaluate/内外重试、视觉POST/模型下载和正常退出。未执行、核发布binary/所有工具/Windows行为或所有cookie/path/权限/业务后置。
只执行本工程的统计和结构验证；没有执行目标插件、测试、安装或真实宿主验收。
GitHub/npm 活跃度只作采集背景，未核实独立用户采用或同条件收益对照。

findings.text: 能隔离测试桌面/浏览器的自动化开发者，为外部Agent提供观察/动作接口；不是DSH插件或完整自主任务循环，见 [Q01](#research-q01)。
平台binary/stdio→MCP确认→单次自动化锁→原生语义或CDP真实执行→text/错误返回；语义链单列候选/派发/局部核验，见 [Q02](#research-q02)。
四材料摘要/固定SOURCE一致；核npm launcher/Cargo版本、Rust stdio/MCP/锁/安全策略、语义缓存/策略/代表macOS AX真实动作与回执、CDP click/evaluate/内外重试、视觉POST/模型下载和正常退出。未执行、核发布binary/所有工具/Windows行为或所有cookie/path/权限/业务后置。
Rust产品crate与npm元包均0.3.3，外部DSH需另插件；包版本不证明各平台发布binary与源码等价，固定日期非包发布日期。

| 依赖或条件 | 是否必需 | 用途 | 缺失或不满足时 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 原生平台binary/或Rust构建、MCP Host | 必需 | stdio工具服务 | npm版本条件非成品校验 |
| OS截屏/辅助功能权限和目标应用 | 桌面时 | 原生观察/执行 | 不自动隔离真实桌面 |
| Windows UIA/macOS AX | 语义时 | opaque候选与动作 | 其他平台可不支持 |
| Chrome/Edge/CDP与浏览器资料 | browser时 | 页面/账号操作 | 状态/资料与退出另核 |
| OCR模型/磁盘/CPU | perceive时 | 本地识别 | 可下载，不能说全离线首用 |
| 视觉Key/端点/外发批准 | vision时 | 带图像HTTP请求 | 可选，独立服务费用/数据边界 |
| 外部Agent/人类批准与业务真值 | 任务采用时 | 下一步和结果判定 | confirm bool不替代独立授权 |

| 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 首次使用 | 平台包/OS权限/浏览器/模型下载未知 | 成品核对、Host配置、隔离样本 | 源码不证明分发字节 |
| 持续使用 | CPU/缓存/图像token/BYOK未知 | 候选和网页适配/业务核对 | 本地OCR不必云视觉，但总费未测 |
| 失败恢复 | 可能已派发/浏览器重连/外部动作未知 | 分未写/未知、重新观察与对账 | 外层写不重试非全底层保证 |
| 退出 | 浏览器profile/cookie/下载/模型/Key | 停MCP、核owned进程、撤权/资料清理 | 不是5秒全清或业务回滚 |
能隔离环境的开发者只在无敏感演示应用逐工具试，未知派发先观察对账，业务完成另核；确认/权限不清则停服务，见 [Q05](#research-q05) 与 [Q06](#research-q06)。

| 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 |
|---|---|---|
| Agent可调用操作 | stdio到原生/CDP/结果 | Host/成品实际任务成功 |
| 语义稳健性 | token/目标/派发与局部核验分层 | 全风险识别/业务目标 |
| 浏览器恢复 | 连接层只重读/写保未知 | 底层stale未派发边界 |
| 感知选择 | 本地OCR/可选云视觉分离 | 准确率/总资源节省 |
[Q02](#research-q02) 派发前消费与后置Unknown保留值得学；[Q03](#research-q03) 必须追到原生/CDP callee再谈不重放，别用外层注释替代全链证明。
统一标准工具、候选/目标绑定、派发前消费观察和未知结果不直接重放，以及连接层区分读恢复与写不确定；这些优势有明确覆盖范围，见 [Q02](#research-q02) 与 [Q03](#research-q03)。
语义局部核验明确非业务完成；原始CDP/像素不共用全部策略，内部stale仍可分类重试；confirm是caller bool且默认off，截图可外发，见 [Q03](#research-q03) 与 [Q04](#research-q04)。
跨工具族绑定人类批准、具体目标与派发不确定性，再为少数业务动作核独立记录真值，未知只读对账不重放，见 [Q06](#research-q06)。

technical.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) 复用原生/浏览器库与MCP，novelty25%非新算法50%；[Q02](#research-q02) token/本地策略/实际原生回执和后置状态组合mechanism75%超薄转发50%，[Q03](#research-q03)跨族重试差异阻100%；标准MCP/平台trait/结果分层transfer75%超单应用50%，非全平台/原始路径统一阻100%；统一入口/平台包与感知选择simplification50%超手拼25%，权限/业务核对仍重阻75%。

business.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02) 观察到局部核验workflow50%超裸点击25%，没有业务接受链不足75%；派发/效果/未知返回delivery50%超字符串成功25%，全族不统一阻75%；MCP及平台元包reach50%高于单Host25%，Linux/权限与成品未验阻75%；相对逐屏必须云视觉的路径，[Q04](#research-q04) 本地OCR/可选云视觉拆分提供资源分配增量economics25%，总token/CPU/质量未知不足50%，未声称实测省钱。

recommendation.reason: 能提供独立测试账户和浏览器资料的 MCP 自动化开发者，可在无敏感演示应用上有限试用语义观察与少量可核动作。相比直接坐标脚本，源码支持候选目标绑定、派发前消费观察和局部后置核验，但业务完成仍需独立判断，原始浏览器与像素操作的权限和重试边界也不相同。若出现未知派发、错误目标或额外脚本写入要求，应停止自动重试，重新观察并由人核实际结果，必要时停用服务和撤销系统权限。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) 外部Agent需桌面/浏览器操作的具体场景50%超泛工具25%，无真实任务频率/代价样本阻75%。

advantage.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02) 相对坐标脚本有目标/候选与不确定性处理结构优势75%超统一入口50%，[Q03](#research-q03)跨族差异/业务无验收阻100%。

evidence.rationale: 已追真实bin/stdio到macOS原生/浏览器callee/回执/视觉请求与退出，见[Q01](#research-q01)至[Q05](#research-q05)，源码50%超接口声明25%，未运行成品/业务样本不升75%。

cost.rationale: [Q04](#research-q04)与[Q05](#research-q05)能先隔离演示/关服务退路25%超不可控直接生产0%，高桌面权限/账号资料/未知派发对账与持久清理仍重，不足50%。

publication.capabilities.table:
| 能力 | 主要用途 | 使用条件与边界 |
|---|---|---|
| 语义桌面 | 观察/候选/原生动作/局部核验 | token/平台/局部策略，非业务成功 |
| 像素/输入 | 直接桌面自动化 | 不共用全部语义约束 |
| CDP | 页面click/JS/cookie等 | 连接写不重试不覆盖所有底层stale |
| OCR/云视觉 | 本地识别或一次图像模型请求 | 下载/外发/账单分开 |
| 正常退出 | owned浏览器关闭/附着断开 | 不删除所有资料/撤销外部效果 |

      "path": "README.md",
      "content": "# nuphus-mcp\n\n[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@nuphus/nuphus-mcp.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@nuphus/nuphus-mcp) [![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/@nuphus/nuphus-mcp.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@nuphus/nuphus-mcp) [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/mrpulor-gh/nuphus-mcp.svg)](https://github.com/mrpulor-gh/nuphus-mcp) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/github/license/mrpulor-gh/nuphus-mcp.svg)](LICENSE) [![CI](https://github.com/mrpulor-gh/nuphus-mcp/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/mrpulor-gh/nuphus-mcp/actions/workflows/ci.yml)\n\n**Desktop automation MCP server — computer use for any AI agent. See the screen, control windows/mouse/keyboard, and drive Chrome over the Model Context Protocol (stdio). Desktop & browser automation need no API key; OCR runs locally; vision plugs into your own vision LLM (OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic native, BYOK).**\n\n`nuphus-mcp` is a lightweight, cross-platform **desktop automation MCP server**\nthat exposes desktop + browser automation as standard MCP tools. It speaks\nJSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio — no daemon, no network service, one binary. Claude\nDesktop, Cursor, VS Code, Copilot, or any MCP client can connect and\nimmediately control the screen, windows, keyboard/mouse, and Chrome —\n**computer use for any AI agent** — desktop & browser automation need no API\nkey; local OCR is built in; vision works with your own vision LLM\n(OpenAI-compatible, BYOK).\n\n> **🇨🇳 Mainland China mirror**: this repo is mirrored on\n> [Gitee](https://gitee.com/nuphus/nuphus-mcp) for fast in-China access\n> (Chinese docs served by default there). [中文文档](README.zh-CN.md)\n>\n> **Part of the Nuphus ecosystem**: [Nuphus](https://github.com/mrpulor-gh/nuphus) — a local-first AI agent with real desktop execution and dual-device (phone-as-second-screen) sync. nuphus-mcp exposes the same desktop + browser automation to any MCP client.\n>\n> **Using DeepSeek Harness (DSH)?** nuphus-mcp itself is a plain stdio MCP server — **not** a DSH/Cordis plugin. Install the dedicated [dsh-nuphus-mcp](https://github.com/mrpulor-gh/dsh-nuphus-mcp) plugin instead (see [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](#deepseek-harness-dsh)).\n\n```\n┌──────────────────┐   stdio JSON-RPC   ┌──────────────────────┐\n│  Any MCP Client  │  ───────────────►  │      nuphus-mcp      │\n│  (Claude/Cursor/ │  ◄───────────────  │  desktop-api crate   │──► screen/window/mouse/keyboard\n│   Nuphus itself) │  single-line JSON  │  nuphus-browser crate│──► Chrome (CDP)\n└──────────────────┘                    └──────────────────────┘\n```\n\n## Features\n\n- **45 MCP tools** (22 desktop + 23 browser) — screenshots, window control,\n  mouse/keyboard, Chrome CDP automation, and more — see [TOOLS.md](TOOLS.md) /\n  [TOOLS.zh-CN.md](TOOLS.zh-CN.md) for the full reference.\n- **Desktop automation**: screen size, screenshot (PNG/base64), window list,\n  window activate/screenshot/move/resize/info, mouse click/drag/scroll/position,\n  keyboard input/hotkey, clipboard write/clean — implemented on the\n  `desktop-api` crate (xcap + Win32, no Tauri dependency).\n- **Semantic desktop (Accessibility/UIA)** — 7 tools that drive native UI through\n  the platform accessibility tree instead of pixel coordinates:\n  `desktop_targets_list`, `desktop_target_bind`, `desktop_semantic_observe`,\n  `desktop_semantic_candidate`, `desktop_semantic_execute`,\n  `desktop_semantic_action`, `desktop_verify_state`. One contract —\n  **observe → pick a candidate → execute → verify** — where native window\n  handles, coordinates and platform locators never cross the MCP boundary; the\n  caller only sees opaque ids and stable semantic locators. Backed by Windows UIA\n  and the macOS Accessibility (AX) API.\n- **Computer vision pair**: `desktop_vision` (BYOK — send a screenshot to your\n  own vision model via an OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic native API) +\n  `desktop_perceive` (local OCR with PaddleOCR, models auto-downloaded on first\n  run; optional YOLO icon detection). Used together they give AI agents **both\n  semantic understanding\n  and pixel-precise coordinates** — the battle-tested vision→perceive flow from\n  the Nuphus desktop app. See [TOOLS.md](TOOLS.md) for BYOK env vars, model\n  setup, and the recommended flow.\n- **Browser automation**: navigate, snapshot (accessibility tree with `@N`\n  refs), click, type, exec, scroll, extract, screenshot, evaluate,\n  back/forward, wait_for, cookies get/set/import, upload, tabs, downloads —\n  implemented on `nuphus-browser` (chromiumoxide CDP).\n- **Zero-cost stdio**: no HTTP server, no daemon. The process reads\n  single-line JSON from stdin and writes responses to stdout.\n- **Safety-first**: destructive tools are annotated per the MCP spec; optional\n  strict-confirm mode; path validation for screenshots, uploads, and file drags.\n\n## Repository Layout\n\n```\nnuphus-mcp/\n├── Cargo.toml                  # workspace root\n├── TOOLS.md / TOOLS.zh-CN.md   # 45-tool reference\n├── crates/\n│   ├── nuphus-mcp/             # MCP Server (this repo's product)\n│   ├── nuphus-browser/         # Browser automation core (CDP)\n│   └── desktop-api/            # Desktop control core (vendored)\n└── ...\n```\n\n## Prerequisites\n\n- **Rust toolchain** (stable) — build from source with Cargo.\n- **Chrome or Edge** — required for browser tools. The server auto-detects an\n  installed browser; if none is found, `browser_*` tools return a clear error.\n- **Windows recommended** for full desktop control — see Platform Support below.\n\n## Platform Support\n\n| Platform | Browser tools | Desktop tools |\n|----------|---------------|---------------|\n| Windows  | Full          | Full (Win32 API) |\n| macOS    | Full          | Semantic (AX) + mouse/keyboard (Accessibility permission required) |\n| Linux    | Available     | Partial — window/input capabilities are limited |\n\n> **Execution HUD**: non-intrusive execution feedback on every platform — Windows shows a compact status card anchored to the bottom-right of the work area, clear of the taskbar/tray (start / done / fail, real-time, styled after the main app HUD), macOS/Linux post a **system notification** on completion (`NUPHUS_MCP_HUD=off` to disable). assert_eq!(frames.len(), MAX_SNAPSHOT_FRAMES);\n        assert_eq!(frames[0].id, \"main\", \"main frame stays first\");\n        assert_eq!(\n            frames.last().map(|f| f.id.as_str()),\n SkippedFrame {\n                label: \"https://pay.example/cb\".to_string(),\n                reason: \"无法读取该框架的可访问性树：Frame not found\".to_string(),\n            },\n            SkippedFrame {\n       "path": "crates/nuphus-browser/src/shared.rs",
      "content": "//! Process-level shared BrowserClient (singleton).\n//!\n//! All browser consumers (browser_tools / web CDP rendering / cookies CDP data source)\n//! reuse the same instance: the embedded browser uses a fixed profile_dir, and multiple\n//! instances concurrently launching the same profile would conflict with each other;\n//! a singleton + mutex eliminates the problem at the root.\n//!\n//! Runtime note: chromiumoxide's CDP handler is `tokio::spawn`ed onto the ambient runtime at\n//! launch, and its lifetime must match BrowserClient. Any browser operation initiated from a\n//! synchronous context runs on [`runtime()`], the process-level resident runtime; temporary\n//! runtimes are forbidden (dropping one kills the handler, leaving a zombie browser connection).\n\nuse std::sync::{Arc, OnceLock};\nuse tokio::sync::{Mutex, OwnedMutexGuard};\n\nuse super::client::BrowserClient;\n\n/// Browser-specific process-level resident tokio runtime (see module docs).\npub fn runtime() -> &'static tokio::runtime::Runtime {\n    static RT: OnceLock<tokio::runtime::Runtime> = OnceLock::new();\n    RT.get_or_init(|| tokio::runtime::Runtime::new().expect(\"failed to create browser runtime\"))\n}\n\n/// Process-level shared BrowserClient handle (lazily initialized; not launched initially).\npub fn shared_client() -> Arc<Mutex<Option<BrowserClient>>> {\n    static INSTANCE: OnceLock<Arc<Mutex<Option<BrowserClient>>>> = OnceLock::new();\n    INSTANCE.get_or_init(|| Arc::new(Mutex::new(None))).clone()\n}\n\n/// How long a browser tool waits for the process-wide client lock before giving\n/// up with a readable \"busy\" error. Every browser tool takes this lock, so an\n/// unbounded wait here is indistinguishable from the whole tool family hanging.\nconst SHARED_CLIENT_LOCK_TIMEOUT_SECS: u64 = 30;\n\n/// get-or-launch: hold the lock to ensure a client exists and launch it per the requested mode, returning an owned guard.\n///\n/// While the caller holds the guard, the browser is exclusively owned, guaranteeing that\n/// navigate/evaluate/cookies etc. CDP operation sequences do not interleave with other consumers;\n/// dropping the guard releases it.\npub async fn get_or_launch(\n    headless: bool,\n) -> Result<OwnedMutexGuard<Option<BrowserClient>>, String> {\n    // Bounded acquisition: this mutex is process-wide and every browser tool\n    // takes it, so a wedged previous operation must not turn every later call\n    // into an unbounded wait (that failure mode reads as \"the whole tool family\n    // hangs, only killing the process helps\", with no error anywhere).\n    let mut guard = match tokio::time::timeout(\n        std::time::Duration::from_secs(SHARED_CLIENT_LOCK_TIMEOUT_SECS),\n        shared_client().lock_owned(),\n    )\n    .await\n    {\n        Ok(guard) => guard,\n        Err(_) => {\n            return Err(format!(\n                \"Browser automation is busy: another operation in this process has held the \\\n                 shared browser client for over {SHARED_CLIENT_LOCK_TIMEOUT_SECS}s; retry later.\"\n            ));\n        }\n    };\n    if guard.is_none() {\n        let client =\n            BrowserClient::new().map_err(|e| format!(\"Browser automation unavailable: {}\", e))?;\n        *guard = Some(client);\n    }\n    let client = guard.as_mut().expect(\"client just initialized\");\n    client\n        .launch(headless)\n        .await\n        .map_err(|e| format!(\"Failed to launch browser: {}\", e))?;\n    Ok(guard)\n}\n\n/// Explicitly shut down the shared browser. Call before process exit.\n///\n/// The shared BrowserClient lives in a process-level `static` (`OnceLock`), and Rust statics are\n/// never dropped on process exit — so `kill_on_drop` on the Chrome child can never fire on its own,\n/// and a gracefully-exiting server would otherwise leave an orphaned Chrome holding the profile lock.\n/// This is the reliable cleanup path: close the CDP connection and kill a Chrome instance this\n/// process launched. An attached external/user browser is only disconnected, never killed.\n/// Bounded to 5s so a wedged CDP connection cannot block process shutdown.\npub async fn shutdown_browser() {\n    let shared = shared_client();\n    let mut guard = shared.lock().await;\n    if let Some(client) = guard.as_mut() {\n        let _ = tokio::time::timeout(std::time::Duration::from_secs(5), client.close()).await;\n    }\n    *guard = None;\n}\n"
    },

      "path": "crates/nuphus-mcp/src/main.rs",
      "content": "//! nuphus-mcp binary entrypoint — stdio JSON-RPC transport layer.\n//!\n//! Protocol: one JSON line over stdin/stdout (matches the stdio client in `src/mcp/client.rs`).\n//! stdout only carries JSON-RPC response lines; all logs go to stderr.\n//!\n//! Security option: `--confirm-write` (or env var `NUPHUS_MCP_CONFIRM_WRITE=1`)\n//! enables strict confirmation mode — write tools require an explicit `\"confirm\": true` argument.\n\nuse tokio::io::{AsyncBufReadExt, AsyncWriteExt, BufReader, BufWriter};\n\nuse nuphus_browser::shutdown_browser;\nuse nuphus_mcp::security::SecurityPolicy;\nuse nuphus_mcp::server::McpServer;\n\n/// Stack size for the thread that runs the stdio loop and every tool dispatch.\n///\n/// The deepest tool path (`browser_navigate` → CDP client → per-command\n/// timeouts → nested chromiumoxide futures) needs far more stack than the\n/// Windows default main-thread stack. On that path the process used to die with\n/// `thread 'main' has overflowed its stack` mid-tool, after which *every*\n/// `tools/call` went unanswered — indistinguishable from a total tool hang, and\n/// only recoverable by killing the process. Running the loop on a dedicated\n/// thread with room to spare removes that failure mode.\nconst SERVE_STACK_BYTES: usize = 64 * 1024 * 1024;\n\nfn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {\n    let handle = std::thread::Builder::new()\n        .name(\"nuphus-mcp-serve\".to_string())\n        .stack_size(SERVE_STACK_BYTES)\n        .spawn(run_serve)?;\n    match handle.join() {\n        Ok(Ok(())) => Ok(()),\n        // Stringified on the serve thread so the error crosses the join safely.\n        Ok(Err(message)) => Err(message.into()),\n        // A panic in the serve thread belongs to the process, not to this\n        // wrapper: resume unwinding so the default handler reports it.\n        Err(payload) => std::panic::resume_unwind(payload),\n    }\n}\n\n/// Build the process runtime and run the stdio loop (on the big-stack thread).\nfn run_serve() -> Result<(), String> {\n    let runtime = tokio::runtime::Builder::new_multi_thread()\n        .enable_all()\n        .build()\n        .map_err(|e| format!(\"failed to build the tokio runtime: {e}\"))?;\n    runtime.block_on(serve()).map_err(|e| e.to_string())\n}\n\nasync fn serve() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {\n    tracing_subscriber::fmt()\n        .with_env_filter(\n            tracing_subscriber::EnvFilter::try_from_default_env()\n                .unwrap_or_else(|_| \"nuphus_mcp=info,warn\".into()),\n        )\n        .with_writer(std::io::stderr) // stdout is reserved for the JSON-RPC protocol\n        .init();\n\n    // --confirm-write CLI flag overrides the environment variable\n    let cli_confirm = std::env::args().any(|a| a == \"--confirm-write\");\n    let policy = if cli_confirm {\n        SecurityPolicy {\n            strict_confirm: true,\n        }\n    } else {\n        SecurityPolicy::from_env()\n    };\n    if policy.strict_confirm {\n        tracing::warn!(\"[nuphus-mcp] STRICT CONFIRM MODE: write tools require \\\"confirm\\\": true\");\n    }\n\n    let mut server = McpServer::with_policy(policy);\n    let stdin = tokio::io::stdin();\n    let mut reader = BufReader::new(stdin);\n    let stdout = tokio::io::stdout();\n    let mut writer = BufWriter::new(stdout);\n\n    let mut line: Vec<u8> = Vec::new();\n    loop {\n        line.clear();\n        let n = match read_line_capped(&mut reader, &mut line, MAX_LINE_BYTES).await {\n            Ok(n) => n,\n            Err(e) => {\n                // Oversized request line: reply with a protocol error and keep serving.\n                let err = serde_json::json!({\n                    \"jsonrpc\": \"2.0\",\n                    \"id\": null,\n                    \"error\": { \"code\": -32700, \"message\": format!(\"request too large: {e}\") }\n                });\n                writer.write_all(err.to_string().as_bytes()).await?;\n                writer.write_all(b\"\\n\").await?;\n                writer.flush().await?;\n                continue;\n            }\n        };\n        if n == 0 {\n            break; // EOF (client closed the pipe / process ended)\n        }\n        // Lossy: a non-UTF-8 line yields replacement chars and is rejected by the JSON\n        // parser with a parse error, instead of aborting the whole server on read.\n        let trimmed = String::from_utf8_lossy(&line);\n        let trimmed = trimmed.trim();\n        if trimmed.is_empty() {\n            continue;\n        }\n        if let Some(response) = server.handle_line(trimmed).await {\n            writer.write_all(response.as_bytes()).await?;\n            writer.write_all(b\"\\n\").await?;\n            writer.flush().await?;\n        }\n        // MCP lifecycle: an `exit` notification terminates the server. Flush any\n        // pending output, then exit 0 when it followed a `shutdown` request,\n        // 1 when the client skipped the graceful shutdown (per spec).\n        if server.exit_received() {\n            writer.flush().await?;\n            let code = server.exit_code();\n            tracing::info!(\"[nuphus-mcp] exit notification received, exiting (code={code})\");\n            // Explicit browser shutdown: the shared client lives in a `static` and is never\n            // dropped on exit, so without this a launched Chrome would be orphaned, holding\n            // the profile lock and destabilizing the next session (see shared::shutdown_browser).\n            shutdown_browser().await;\n            std::process::exit(code as i32);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // stdin EOF (host closed the pipe): same explicit cleanup before returning.\n    tracing::info!(\"[nuphus-mcp] stdin EOF, shutting down\");\n    shutdown_browser().await;\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Max bytes per JSON-RPC request line. Requests larger than this are rejected with a\n/// parse error rather than letting the buffer grow without bound (defense-in-depth for\n/// a misbehaving host process).\nconst MAX_LINE_BYTES: usize = 4 * 1024 * 1024;\n\n/// Read a single LF-terminated line with a hard byte cap.\n///\n/// Returns the number of bytes read (0 on EOF). If the line exceeds `max`, the rest of\n/// the line is drained to keep the stream aligned and `Err` is returned so the caller\n/// can emit a protocol error and continue serving.\nasync fn read_line_capped(\n    reader: &mut BufReader<tokio::io::Stdin>,\n    out: &mut Vec<u8>,\n    max: usize,\n) -> std::io::Result<usize> {\n    use std::io::ErrorKind;\n    loop {\n        let buf = reader.fill_buf().await?;\n        if buf.is_empty() {\n            return Ok(out.len()); // EOF\n        }\n        let newline = buf\n            .iter()\n            .position(|&b| b == b'\\n')\n            .map(|i| i + 1)\n            .unwrap_or(buf.len());\n        if out.len() + newline > max {\n            let mut rest = Vec::new();\n            let _ = reader.read_until(b'\\n', &mut rest).await; // drain to stay aligned\n            return Err(std::io::Error::new(\n                ErrorKind::InvalidData,\n                format!(\"request line exceeds {max} byte limit\"),\n            ));\n        }\n        out.extend_from_slice(&buf[..newline]);\n        // Stop at the line terminator; if the whole chunk was consumed without a\n        // newline, keep buffering the next chunk.\n        let ended = newline < buf.len() || buf[newline - 1] == b'\\n';\n        reader.consume(newline);\n        if ended {\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n    Ok(out.len())\n}\n"
    },

      "path": "crates/nuphus-mcp/src/models.rs",
      "content": "//! `desktop_perceive` local model management — downloads the PaddleOCR models and the YOLO icon\n//! detection model automatically on first run (both are part of the same perceive pipeline).\n//!\n//! Model files land in the same location as the main app (`NUPHUS_MODELS_DIR` or `data_dir/Nuphus/models`),\n//! resolved by `vision::models` in desktop-api. Download sources mirror the main crate's build.rs:\n//! - Detection/recognition ONNX: `hf-mirror.com/SWHL/RapidOCR` (HuggingFace mirror),\n//!   falling back to the official `huggingface.co` source on failure.\n//! - Character dictionary: `gitee.com/paddlepaddle/PaddleOCR`.\n//! - YOLO `icon_detect.onnx`: `onnx-community/OmniParser-icon_detect_640x640` ONNX export\n//!   (`hf-mirror.com` first, `huggingface.co` fallback); the same I/O contract as the Nuphus\n//!   exported model (`images [1,3,640,640]` → `output0 [1,5,8400]`).\n//!\n//! YOLO stays optional at runtime: if its download fails, perceive runs in OCR-only mode and\n//! honestly reports YOLO as unavailable. Users can pin a custom source (e.g. a private mirror or\n//! the full ~80MB OmniParser export) via `NUPHUS_MCP_YOLO_MODEL_URL`.\n\nuse std::path::PathBuf;\nuse std::time::Duration;\n\nuse desktop_api::vision::models::{\n    models_dir_for_write, validate_ocr_models, yolo_model_available, PADDLE_OCR_FILES, YOLO_MODEL,\n};\n\n/// Model readiness status (used by desktop_perceive).\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct ModelStatus {\n    pub dir: PathBuf,\n    /// Whether the PaddleOCR trio is complete (hard prerequisite for perceive)\n    pub ocr_ready: bool,\n    /// Whether the YOLO icon detection model is available (optional enhancement)\n    pub yolo_available: bool,\n    /// Files actually downloaded by this call\n    pub downloaded: Vec<String>,\n}\n\n/// Candidate download sources per file (tried in order).\nfn sources_for(file: &str) -> Vec<&'static str> {\n    match file {\n        \"ch_PP-OCRv4_det.onnx\" => vec![\n            \"https://hf-mirror.com/SWHL/RapidOCR/resolve/main/PP-OCRv4/ch_PP-OCRv4_det_infer.onnx\",\n            \"https://huggingface.co/SWHL/RapidOCR/resolve/main/PP-OCRv4/ch_PP-OCRv4_det_infer.onnx\",\n        ],\n        \"ch_PP-OCRv4_rec.onnx\" => vec![\n            \"https://hf-mirror.com/SWHL/RapidOCR/resolve/main/PP-OCRv4/ch_PP-OCRv4_rec_infer.onnx\",\n            \"https://huggingface.co/SWHL/RapidOCR/resolve/main/PP-OCRv4/ch_PP-OCRv4_rec_infer.onnx\",\n        ],\n        \"ch_PP-OCR_keys_v1.txt\" => {\n            vec![\"https://gitee.com/paddlepaddle/PaddleOCR/raw/main/ppocr/utils/ppocr_keys_v1.txt\"]\n        }\n        _ => vec![],\n    }\n}\n\n/// Ensure local models are ready: auto-download the PaddleOCR files and the YOLO icon detection\n/// model together on first run.\n///\n/// - OCR files all present or downloaded successfully → `Ok(status)` (`yolo_available` reported honestly).\n/// - Any OCR file download fails → `Err` (clear error + manual download instructions), no panic.\n/// - YOLO download failure is **not** fatal: perceive degrades to OCR-only and reports `yolo_available=false`.\n/// - Setting `NUPHUS_MCP_NO_MODEL_DOWNLOAD=1` skips both downloads (fast-fail for restricted networks/CI:\n///   existence-only check that returns a clear error).\npub async fn ensure_models() -> Result<ModelStatus, String> {\n    let dir = models_dir_for_write()?;\n    let mut downloaded: Vec<String> = Vec::new();\n\n    let skip_download = std::env::var(\"NUPHUS_MCP_NO_MODEL_DOWNLOAD\")\n        .map(|v| v == \"1\" || v.eq_ignore_ascii_case(\"true\"))\n        .unwrap_or(false);\n\n    // Validate first, to avoid unnecessary requests when everything is already present.\n    // One shared client covers the OCR trio and the YOLO model.\n    let ocr_missing = validate_ocr_models(&dir).is_err();\n    let yolo_missing = !yolo_model_available(&dir);\n    if !skip_download && (ocr_missing || yolo_missing) {\n        let client = reqwest::Client::builder()\n            .timeout(Duration::from_secs(120))\n            .build()\n            .map_err(|e| format!(\"build http client failed: {}\", e))?;\n\n        if ocr_missing {\n            for file in PADDLE_OCR_FILES {\n                let dest = dir.join(file);\n                if dest.exists() {\n                    continue;\n                }\n                let sources = sources_for(file);\n                if sources.is_empty() {\n                    continue;\n                }\n                match download_with_fallback(&client, &sources, &dest).await {\n                    Ok(()) => {\n                        downloaded.push(file.to_string());\n                    }\n                    Err(e) => {\n                        return Err(format!(\n                            \"desktop_perceive model download failed for {file}: {e}\\n\\\n                             Please download the following files manually into {}:\\n  - ch_PP-OCRv4_det.onnx ← https://hf-mirror.com/SWHL/RapidOCR\\n  - ch_PP-OCRv4_rec.onnx ← https://hf-mirror.com/SWHL/RapidOCR\\n  - ch_PP-OCR_keys_v1.txt ← https://gitee.com/paddlepaddle/PaddleOCR\",\n                            dir.display()\n                        ));\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // YOLO icon detection model — same download pipeline as the OCR files, including the\n        // size floor and the ONNX trial-load gate. A failure is downgraded, not fatal.\n        if yolo_missing {\n            let dest = dir.join(YOLO_MODEL);\n            match download_with_fallback(&client, &yolo_sources(), &dest).await {\n                Ok(()) => downloaded.push(YOLO_MODEL.to_string()),\n                Err(e) => tracing::warn!(\n                    \"[models] YOLO model download failed, perceive continues in OCR-only mode: {e}\"\n                ),\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Final validation: OCR must be complete, otherwise report an error (with missing files)\n    validate_ocr_models(&dir).map_err(|e| {\n        format!(\n            \"{e}\\nAutomatic download did not complete. Please check your network and retry, or place the model files manually in {}\",\n            dir.display()\n        )\n    })?;\n\n    Ok(ModelStatus {\n        dir: dir.clone(),\n        ocr_ready: true,\n        yolo_available: yolo_model_available(&dir),\n        downloaded,\n    })\n}\n\n/// YOLO `icon_detect.onnx` download sources (tried in order).\n///\n/// `NUPHUS_MCP_YOLO_MODEL_URL` overrides the default entirely — for a private mirror or the full\n/// ~80MB OmniParser export. Default: onnx-community's OmniParser icon_detect 640x640 ONNX export,\n/// which exposes the same I/O contract the YOLO runtime expects\n/// (`images [1,3,640,640]` → `output0 [1,5,8400]`), via hf-mirror.com first (China-friendly),\n/// huggingface.co fallback.\nfn yolo_sources() -> Vec<String> {\n    if let Ok(url) = std::env::var(\"NUPHUS_MCP_YOLO_MODEL_URL\") {\n        let url = url.trim().to_string();\n        if !url.is_empty() {\n            return vec![url];\n        }\n    }\n    vec![\n        \"https://hf-mirror.com/onnx-community/OmniParser-icon_detect_640x640/resolve/main/onnx/model.onnx\"\n            .to_string(),\n        \"https://huggingface.co/onnx-community/OmniParser-icon_detect_640x640/resolve/main/onnx/model.onnx\"\n            .to_string(),\n    ]\n}\n\n/// Try each candidate source in order; return Err if all fail.\nasync fn download_with_fallback<S: AsRef<str>>(\n    client: &reqwest::Client,\n    sources: &[S],\n    dest: &std::path::Path,\n) -> Result<(), String> {\n    let mut last_err: Option<String> = None;\n    for url in sources {\n        match download_file(client, url.as_ref(), dest).await {\n            Ok(()) => return Ok(()),\n            Err(e) => last_err = Some(e),\n        }\n    }\n    Err(last_err.unwrap_or_else(|| \"no source\".to_string()))\n}\n\n/// Minimum accepted file size per model (bytes).\n///\n/// Guards against empty/truncated downloads that succeed with HTTP 200 but carry an\n/// error page or a partial body. Real artifacts: det ~4.7 MB, rec ~10.8 MB,\n/// dictionary ~26 KB (measured from the official RapidOCR/PaddleOCR sources), so\n/// these floors can never reject a real artifact while being 10x stricter than a\n/// generic 100 KB floor. Resident runtime discipline: the browser CDP handler is `tokio::spawn`ed onto the ambient runtime.\n//! nuphus-mcp's stdio loop runs on a process-level tokio runtime (lifetime = process),\n//! so here we `.await` `get_or_launch` directly (no nested `runtime().block_on`).\n\nuse nuphus_browser::{BrowserClient, BrowserError};\nuse serde_json::Value;\nuse std::time::Duration;\n\n/// Every browser_* tool that has a dispatch branch in `run_op_with_reconnect`.\n///\n/// Keep in sync with the match arms below. A tool registered in `schemas::all_tools`\n/// without a branch here is a schema/dispatch mismatch that only surfaces at\n/// tools/call time as \"Unknown browser tool\" (regression: 1978fc7 dropped\n/// `browser_close` + 3 cookie tools). The `dispatch_matches_schema` test enforces this.\npub const EXECUTABLE_BROWSER_TOOLS: &[&str] = &[\n    \"browser_navigate\",\n    \"browser_back\",\n    \"browser_forward\",\n    \"browser_snapshot\",\n    \"browser_exec\",\n    \"browser_click\",\n    \"browser_type\",\n    \"browser_press\",\n    \"browser_scroll\",\n    \"browser_screenshot\",\n    \"browser_extract\",\n    \"browser_close\",\n    \"browser_cookies_get\",\n    \"browser_cookies_set\",\n    \"browser_import_cookies\",\n    \"browser_evaluate\",\n    \"browser_wait_for\",\n    \"browser_upload\",\n    \"browser_drag_files\",\n    \"browser_list_downloads\",\n    \"browser_new_tab\",\n    \"browser_list_tabs\",\n    \"browser_switch_tab\",\n];\n\n/// Allowed navigation URL schemes. Rejects `file://`, `javascript:`, `data:` etc.,\n/// which could otherwise read local files or bypass page-context sandboxing.\n/// SSRF guard: private/loopback/link-local hosts are refused by default\n/// (`NUPHUS_MCP_ALLOW_PRIVATE_NAV=1` is the explicit escape hatch for intranet use).\nfn validate_nav_url(url: &str) -> Result<(), String> {\n    let url = url.trim();\n    if url.is_empty() {\n        return Err(\"url parameter must not be empty\".to_string());\n    }\n    let lower = url.to_ascii_lowercase();\n    if lower.starts_with(\"http://\") || lower.starts_with(\"https://\") {\n        if private_nav_allowed() {\n            return Ok(());\n        }\n        if let Some(host) = nav_host(url) {\n            if host_is_private(&host) {\n                return Err(format!(\n                    \"navigation to private/loopback/link-local host '{host}' is refused by default \\\n                     (SSRF guard); set NUPHUS_MCP_ALLOW_PRIVATE_NAV=1 to allow intranet targets\"\n                ));\n            }\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    } else {\n        Err(format!(\n            \"unsupported URL scheme (only http/https allowed): {url}\"\n        ))\n    }\n}\n\nfn private_nav_allowed() -> bool {\n    std::env::var(\"NUPHUS_MCP_ALLOW_PRIVATE_NAV\")\n        .map(|v| v == \"1\" || v.eq_ignore_ascii_case(\"true\"))\n        .unwrap_or(false)\n}\n\n/// Extract the host portion of an http(s) URL without pulling in a URL crate:\n/// strip scheme → strip userinfo → take up to the first `/` → strip port.\nfn nav_host(url: &str) -> Option<String> {\n    let after_scheme = url.split_once(\"://\").map(|(_, rest)| rest)?;\n    let authority = after_scheme.split('/').next()?;\n    let host_port = authority.rsplit('@').next()?;\n    let host = if let Some(stripped) = host_port.strip_prefix('[') {\n        // [IPv6]:port\n        stripped.split(']').next()?.to_string()\n    } else {\n        host_port.split(':').next()?.to_string()\n    };\n    if host.is_empty() {\n        None\n    } else {\n        Some(host)\n    }\n}\n\n/// Whether the host is loopback / private / link-local / unspecified, as a\n/// literal IP or a localhost-style name. DNS-rebinding via public hostnames is\n/// out of scope (that requires resolution-time checks).\nfn host_is_private(host: &str) -> bool {\n    let h = host.to_ascii_lowercase();\n    if h == \"localhost\" || h.ends_with(\".localhost\") {\n        return true;\n    }\n    if let Ok(ip) = h.parse::<std::net::Ipv4Addr>() {\n        // 127/8, 10/8 + 172.16/12 + 192.168/16, 169.254/16, 0.0.0.0\n        return ip.is_loopback() || ip.is_private() || ip.is_link_local() || ip.is_unspecified();\n    }\n    if let Ok(ip6) = h.parse::<std::net::Ipv6Addr>() {\n        let seg0 = ip6.segments()[0];\n        let link_local = (seg0 & 0xffc0) == 0xfe80; // fe80::/10\n        let ula = (seg0 & 0xfe00) == 0xfc00; // fc00::/7\n        return ip6.is_loopback() || ip6.is_unspecified() || link_local || ula;\n    }\n    false\n}\n\n/// Post-action effect-verification window (ms) for write operations that can\n/// silently no-op (click/type). A change detected within this window means the\n/// action took effect; an unchanged page means it very likely did not.\n/// Default 15s; `NUPHUS_MCP_EFFECT_TIMEOUT_MS=0` disables the check entirely.\nfn effect_timeout_ms() -> u64 {\n    std::env::var(\"NUPHUS_MCP_EFFECT_TIMEOUT_MS\")\n        .ok()\n        .and_then(|v| v.trim().parse::<u64>().ok())\n        .unwrap_or(15_000)\n}\n\n/// Resolve the shared `selector` / `ref` tool contract and reject missing or\n/// blank values before any page-side effect is attempted.\nfn selector_or_ref<'a>(tool: &str, args: &'a Value) -> Result<&'a str, BrowserError> {\n    args.get(\"selector\")\n        .and_then(Value::as_str)\n        .filter(|value| !value.trim().is_empty())\n        .or_else(|| {\n            args.get(\"ref\")\n                .and_then(Value::as_str)\n                .filter(|value| !value.trim().is_empty())\n        })\n        .ok_or_else(|| {\n            BrowserError::Execution(format!(\"{tool}: selector or ref parameter is required\"))\n        })\n}\n\n/// Execute a browser_* tool, returning a text result.\npub async fn execute(name: &str, args: &Value) -> Result<String, String> {\n    // Per-operation budget (same policy as the main crate's browser_tools.rs).\n    let timeout_secs: u64 = match name {\n        \"browser_navigate\" | \"browser_back\" | \"browser_forward\" => 30,\n        \"browser_exec\" => 15,\n        // click/type additionally wait the effect-verification window after the\n        // action, so budget = action timeout + that window.\n        \"browser_click\" | \"browser_type\" => 15 + effect_timeout_ms() / 1000,\n        \"browser_wait_for\" => {\n            args.get(\"timeout_ms\")\n                .and_then(Value::as_u64)\n                .unwrap_or(5000)\n                / 1000\n                + 5\n        }\n        _ => 15,\n    };\n    // Outer total budget: one operation + reconnect probe (3s) + Chrome relaunch (~10s) + one retry.\n    let total_budget = timeout_secs + 25;\n    tokio::time::timeout(\n        Duration::from_secs(total_budget),\n        run_tool(name, args, timeout_secs),\n    )\n    .await\n    .map_err(|_| format!(\"Browser '{}' timed out after {}s\", name, total_budget))?\n}\n\n/// Hold the lock while executing a specific tool (exclusive browser access, avoid interleaving with other consumers).\n/// Every operation runs through connection-level self-healing: a dead CDP connection (killed / crashed Chrome)\n/// is automatically reset, relaunched and retried once, so a mid-workflow browser death does not turn\n/// into a string of user-visible errors.\nasync fn run_tool(name: &str, args: &Value, timeout_secs: u64) -> Result<String, String> {\n    // MCP scenarios use a visible browser window (same as the main crate's browser_tools)\n    let mut guard = nuphus_browser::get_or_launch(false)\n        .await\n        .map_err(|e| MCP tool registry: schema exposure + name dispatch execution.\n\npub mod browser;\npub mod desktop;\nmod schemas;\npub mod semantic;\n\npub use schemas::{all_tools, ToolDef};\n\n/// How long a tool waits for the process-level automation lock (the one that\n/// serializes automation inside this process) before failing with \"busy\".\n/// It is acquired *outside* every per-tool budget, so it needs its own bound.\nconst PROCESS_LOCK_TIMEOUT_SECS: u64 = 30;\n\n/// Tool execution result\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct ToolOutput {\n    /// Text content (tools/call content[].text)\n    pub text: String,\n    /// Whether it is a semantic error (true → tools/call returns isError: true)\n    pub is_error: bool,\n}\n\nimpl ToolOutput {\n    pub fn success(text: impl Into<String>) -> Self {\n        Self {\n            text: text.into(),\n            is_error: false,\n        }\n    }\n\n    pub fn failure(text: impl Into<String>) -> Self {\n        Self {\n            text: text.into(),\n            is_error: true,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Execute a tool by name. Unknown tool names return Err (→ JSON-RPC -32602).\n///\n/// Automation safety: desktop and browser automation operate on exclusive machine\n/// resources (mouse/keyboard/screen/browser). Only one Agent may run an automation\n/// operation at any moment:\n/// - **Process-level**: a process-wide tokio Mutex serializes all automation calls\n///   within this server instance (a stdio loop is sequential anyway; this also makes\n///   parallel test execution deterministic).\n/// - **Cross-process**: a file lock coordinates multiple MCP server instances (one\n///   per Agent via stdio) through `{data_dir}/Nuphus/nuphus-mcp/automation.lock`.\n/// The lock is held only for the duration of this call (short hold), released on return.\npub async fn execute(name: &str, args: &serde_json::Value) -> Result<ToolOutput, String> {\n    // Process-level mutual exclusion: serialize automation operations within this\n    // process. Held across the await points of the actual tool call.\n    // Bounded: this lock sits *outside* every per-tool budget, so an unbounded\n    // wait here would wedge the whole server (one stuck tool = every later call\n    // unanswered). Give up with a readable busy error instead.\n    static PROCESS_LOCK: std::sync::OnceLock<tokio::sync::Mutex<()>> = std::sync::OnceLock::new();\n    let process_guard = match tokio::time::timeout(\n        std::time::Duration::from_secs(PROCESS_LOCK_TIMEOUT_SECS),\n        PROCESS_LOCK\n            .get_or_init(|| tokio::sync::Mutex::new(()))\n            .lock(),\n    )\n    .await\n    {\n        Ok(guard) => guard,\n        Err(_) => {\n            return Ok(ToolOutput::failure(format!(\n                \"Automation is busy: another operation in this process has held the automation \\\n                 lock for over {PROCESS_LOCK_TIMEOUT_SECS}s; retry later.\"\n            )));\n        }\n    };\n\n    // Cross-process lock: full coverage for every desktop_*/browser_* tool.\n    // Read-only operations (e.g. desktop_screen_size) also acquire it — they still\n    // touch the shared machine state and must not interleave with a writer's sequence.\n    let lock = crate::automation_lock::AutomationLock::new();\n    let file_guard = match lock.acquire(name) {\n        Ok(guard) => guard,\n        Err(e) => return Ok(ToolOutput::failure(e)),\n    };\n\n    // Test-only panic hook: exercised by the server panic-guard test to prove a\n    // panicking tool cannot kill the process and that both locks above are\n    // released by RAII while the panic unwinds. This is the same protocol shape\n//! as `src/desktop/vision_ocr.rs` in the main crate, but **fully independent**: it does not depend on the main\n//! crate's config/registry system, reading env vars directly:\n//!\n//! | Env var | Required | Default | Description |\n//! |---------|----------|---------|-------------|\n//! | `NUPHUS_MCP_VISION_API_KEY` | ✅ | - | API key (missing → explicit error) |\n//! | `NUPHUS_MCP_VISION_BASE_URL` | - | `https://api.openai.com/v1` | Provider base URL (Anthropic: `https://api.anthropic.com/v1`) |\n//! | `NUPHUS_MCP_VISION_MODEL` | ✅ | - | Vision model ID (e.g. `gpt-4o-mini`, `qwen-vl-max`, `claude-sonnet-4-5`) |\n//! | `NUPHUS_MCP_VISION_PROVIDER` | - | `auto` | `auto` \\| `openai` \\| `anthropic`; `auto` infers from the base URL host |\n//! | `NUPHUS_MCP_VISION_MAX_TOKENS` | - | `1024` | Max output tokens (1..=32768). Default 1024 = the compatibility floor for Chinese OpenAI-compatible providers (e.g. Zhipu GLM-4V-Flash caps at 1024); raise it for text-heavy screenshots |\n//!\n//! When key/model are not configured, returns a clear error: no panic, no silent \"fake green\" degradation.\n\nuse serde_json::{json, Value};\n\n/// Vision provider backend. After config resolution this is never [`VisionProvider::Auto`].\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum VisionProvider {\n    /// Infer from the base URL host (`anthropic` in host → Anthropic native, otherwise OpenAI-compatible).\n    Auto,\n    /// OpenAI-compatible `/chat/completions` (works with OpenAI, Azure, Ollama, vLLM, MiniMax, Qwen, …).\n    OpenAI,\n    /// Anthropic native Messages API (`/messages`, `x-api-key` + `anthropic-version`).\n    Anthropic,\n}\n\nimpl VisionProvider {\n    fn from_env_str(s: &str) -> Result<Self, String> {\n        match s.trim().to_ascii_lowercase().as_str() {\n            \"auto\" => Ok(Self::Auto),\n            \"openai\" | \"openai-compatible\" => Ok(Self::OpenAI),\n            \"anthropic\" | \"claude\" => Ok(Self::Anthropic),\n            other => Err(format!(\n                \"NUPHUS_MCP_VISION_PROVIDER must be one of auto|openai|anthropic, got: {other}\"\n            )),\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Resolve `Auto` against a base URL. `anthropic` anywhere in the host → Anthropic native\n    /// (this also covers Anthropic-compatible third-party gateways, e.g. `api.minimax.io/anthropic`).\n    fn resolve(self, base_url: &str) -> Self {\n        match self {\n            Self::Auto => {\n                if base_url.to_ascii_lowercase().contains(\"anthropic\") {\n                    Self::Anthropic\n                } else {\n                    Self::OpenAI\n                }\n            }\n            other => other,\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Human label for error messages / debugging.\n    pub fn label(self) -> &'static str {\n        match self {\n            Self::Auto => \"auto\",\n            Self::OpenAI => \"OpenAI-compatible\",\n            Self::Anthropic => \"Anthropic\",\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// BYOK vision config (parsed from environment variables).\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct VisionConfig {\n    pub api_key: String,\n    pub base_url: String,\n    pub model: String,\n    /// Max output tokens. Default 1024 (Zhipu GLM-4V-Flash caps at 1024); override via `NUPHUS_MCP_VISION_MAX_TOKENS`.\n    pub max_tokens: u32,\n    /// Resolved provider — never [`VisionProvider::Auto`] after [`VisionConfig::from_env`].\n    pub provider: VisionProvider,\n}\n\nimpl VisionConfig {\n    /// Read config from environment variables. Returns a clear error for missing required fields.\n    pub fn from_env() -> Result<Self, String> {\n        let api_key = std::env::var(\"NUPHUS_MCP_VISION_API_KEY\")\n            .map_err(|_| \"NUPHUS_MCP_VISION_API_KEY required: set this environment variable to your vision model API key (BYOK)\".to_string())?;\n        if api_key.trim().is_empty() {\n            return Err(\"NUPHUS_MCP_VISION_API_KEY required: value must not be empty\".to_string());\n        }\n\n        let model = std::env::var(\"NUPHUS_MCP_VISION_MODEL\")\n            .map_err(|_| \"NUPHUS_MCP_VISION_MODEL required: set the vision model id (e.g. gpt-4o-mini, qwen-vl-max, claude-sonnet-4-5)\".to_string())?;\n        if model.trim().is_empty() {\n            return Err(\"NUPHUS_MCP_VISION_MODEL required: value must not be empty\".to_string());\n        }\n\n        let base_url = std::env::var(\"NUPHUS_MCP_VISION_BASE_URL\")\n            .unwrap_or_else(|_| \"https://api.openai.com/v1\".to_string());\n        let base_url = base_url.trim_end_matches('/').to_string();\n\n        // Enforce HTTPS: screenshots sent to a remote endpoint must not leak over\n        // plaintext. Loopback (localhost/127.0.0.1) is allowed over http for local\n        // test endpoints (e.g. Ollama).\n        let is_loopback = match reqwest::Url::parse(&base_url) {\n            Ok(u) => matches!(u.host_str(), Some(\"localhost\" | \"127.0.0.1\" | \"::1\")),\n            Err(_) => false,\n        };\n        if base_url.starts_with(\"http://\") && !is_loopback {\n            return Err(format!(\n                \"NUPHUS_MCP_VISION_BASE_URL must use https (plain http is only allowed for localhost/127.0.0.1 test endpoints): {base_url}\"\n            ));\n        }\n\n        let provider = match std::env::var(\"NUPHUS_MCP_VISION_PROVIDER\") {\n            Ok(s) => VisionProvider::from_env_str(&s)?,\n            Err(_) => VisionProvider::Auto,\n        }\n        .resolve(&base_url);\n\n        // Max output tokens: default 1024 (the compatibility floor for Chinese OpenAI-compatible\n        // providers — Zhipu GLM-4V-Flash rejects anything above 1024 with a 400). Configurable so\n        // text-heavy screenshots can request more from providers that allow it (Claude, GPT-4o, …).\n        let max_tokens = match std::env::var(\"NUPHUS_MCP_VISION_MAX_TOKENS\") {\n            Ok(s) => s.trim().parse::<u32>().map_err(|_| {\n                format!(\"NUPHUS_MCP_VISION_MAX_TOKENS must be a positive integer, got: {s}\")\n            })?,\n            Err(_) => 1024,\n        };\n        if max_tokens == 0 || max_tokens > 32768 {\n            return Err(format!(\n                \"NUPHUS_MCP_VISION_MAX_TOKENS must be in 1..=32768, got: {max_tokens}\"\n            ));\n        }\n\n        Ok(Self {\n            api_key,\n            base_url,\n            model,\n            max_tokens,\n            provider,\n        })\n    }\n}\n\n/// Default prompt (used when no prompt parameter is given; English to be compatible with any vision model).\npub const DEFAULT_PROMPT: &str =\n    \"Describe the contents of this image in detail. If it contains readable text, output the text verbatim.\";\n\n/// OpenAI-compatible request: (url, body). Base64 image as an `image_url` data-URL content block.\nfn openai_request(\n    model: &str,\n    base_url: &str,\n    mime_type: &str,\n    base64_image: &str,\n    prompt: &str,\n    max_tokens: u32,\n) -> (String, Value) {\n    let data_url = format!(\"data:{mime_type};base64,{base64_image}\");\n    let body = json!({\n        \"model\": model,\n        \"messages\": [\n            {\n                \"role\": \"user\",\n                \"content\": [\n                    { \"type\": \"text\", \"text\": prompt },\n                    {\n                        \"type\": \"image_url\",\n                        \"image_url\": { \"url\": data_url, \"detail\": \"high\" }\n                    }\n                ]\n            }\n        ],\n        \"max_tokens\": max_tokens\n    });\n    (format!(\"{base_url}/chat/completions\"), body)\n}\n\n/// Anthropic native Messages request: (url, body). Base64 image as an `image` source block.\nfn anthropic_request(\n    model: &str,\n    base_url: &str,\n    mime_type: &str,\n    base64_image: &str,\n    prompt: &str,\n    max_tokens: u32,\n) -> (String, Value) {\n    let body = json!({\n        \"model\": model,\n        \"max_tokens\": max_tokens,\n        \"messages\": [\n            {\n                \"role\": \"user\",\n                \"content\": [\n                    {\n                        \"type\": \"image\",\n                        \"source\": {\n                            \"type\": \"base64\",\n                            \"media_type\": mime_type,\n                            \"data\": base64_image\n                        }\n                    },\n                    { \"type\": \"text\", \"text\": prompt }\n                ]\n            }\n        ]\n    });\n    (format!(\"{base_url}/messages\"), body)\n}\n\n/// Auth (and version) headers for the selected provider.\nfn provider_headers(provider: VisionProvider, api_key: &str) -> Vec<(String, String)> {\n    match provider {\n        VisionProvider::Anthropic => vec![\n            (\"x-api-key\".into(), api_key.into()),\n            (\"anthropic-version\".into(), \"2023-06-01\".into()),\n        ],\n        VisionProvider::OpenAI | VisionProvider::Auto => {\n            vec![(\"authorization\".into(), format!(\"Bearer {api_key}\"))]\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// OpenAI-compatible response: `choices[0].message.content` (string).\nfn parse_openai_response(resp: &Value) -> Result<String, String> {\n    let text = resp[\"choices\"][0][\"message\"][\"content\"]\n        .as_str()\n        .unwrap_or(\"\")\n        .trim()\n        .to_string();\n    if text.is_empty() {\n        return Err(\"vision API returned empty content\".to_string());\n    }\n    Ok(text)\n}\n\n/// Anthropic native response: join all `content[*]` text blocks.\nfn parse_anthropic_response(resp: &Value) -> Result<String, String> {\n    let text = resp[\"content\"]\n        .as_array()\n        .map(|blocks| {\n            blocks\n                .iter()\n                .filter(|b| b[\"type\"] == \"text\")\n                .filter_map(|b| b[\"text\"].as_str())\n                .collect::<String>()\n        })\n        .unwrap_or_default()\n        .trim()\n        .to_string();\n    if text.is_empty() {\n        return Err(\"vision API returned empty content\".to_string());\n    }\n    Ok(text)\n}\n\n/// Run vision understanding on an image, returning the model's text reply.\n///\n/// - `image_path`: local image path (BMP/PNG both accepted; BMP is auto-converted to PNG before sending).\n/// - `prompt`: optional prompt, defaults to [`DEFAULT_PROMPT`].\npub async fn vision_image(image_path: &str, prompt: Option<&str>) -> Result<String, String> {\n    let config = VisionConfig::from_env()?;\n\n    // 1. Read image → convert to PNG (LLM APIs generally do not accept image/bmp)\n    let image_bytes = std::fs::read(image_path).map_err(|e| format!(\"read image failed: {}\", e))?;\n    let (mime_type, final_bytes) = if image_path.to_lowercase().ends_with(\".png\") {\n        (\"image/png\", image_bytes)\n    } else {\n        let img = image::load_from_memory(&image_bytes)\n            .map_err(|e| format!(\"decode image failed: {}\", e))?;\n        let mut png_buf = std::io::Cursor::new(Vec::new());\n        img.write_to(&mut png_buf, image::ImageFormat::Png)\n            .map_err(|e| format!(\"convert to PNG failed: {}\", e))?;\n        (\"image/png\", png_buf.into_inner())\n    };\n\n    use base64::Engine;\n    let base64_image = base64::engine::general_purpose::STANDARD.encode(&final_bytes);\n\n    // 2. Build provider request\n    let prompt_text = prompt.filter(|p| !p.is_empty()).unwrap_or(DEFAULT_PROMPT);\n    let (url, body) = if config.provider == VisionProvider::Anthropic {\n        anthropic_request(\n            &config.model,\n            &config.base_url,\n            mime_type,\n            &base64_image,\n            prompt_text,\n            config.max_tokens,\n        )\n    } else {\n        openai_request(\n            &config.model,\n            &config.base_url,\n            mime_type,\n            &base64_image,\n            prompt_text,\n            config.max_tokens,\n        )\n    };\n\n    // 3. POST\n    let client = reqwest::Client::builder()\n        .timeout(std::time::Duration::from_secs(120))\n        .build()\n        .map_err(|e| format!(\"build http client failed: {}\", e))?;\n\n    let mut request = client.post(&url).header(\"Content-Type\", \"application/json\");\n    for (k, v) in provider_headers(config.provider, &config.api_key) {\n        request = request.header(k, v);\n    }\n    let response = request\n        .json(&body)\n        .send()\n        .await\n        .map_err(|e| format!(\"vision API request failed: {}\", e))?;\n\n    if !response.status().is_success() {\n        let status = response.status().as_u16();\n        let err_body = response.text().await.unwrap_or_default();\n        return Err(format_vision_error(\n            config.provider.label(),\n            &config.model,\n            Some(status),\n            &err_body,\n        ));\n    }\n\n    // 4. Parse response\n    let resp_json: Value = response\n        .json()\n        .await\n        .map_err(|e| format!(\"parse vision API response failed: {}\", e))?;\n\n    if config.provider == VisionProvider::Anthropic {\n        parse_anthropic_response(&resp_json)\n    } else {\n        parse_openai_response(&resp_json)\n    }\n}\n\n// ══════════════════════════════════════════════\n// Failure classification & single-layer error copy\n// (synced from the main crate's `src/desktop/vision_ocr.rs` — same keyword\n// tables and priority order, so a failure reads the same in both products)\n// ══════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n/// Failure kinds for a vision API call — pure status/keyword matching, no extra deps.\n///\n/// The kind decides the \"way out\" sentence in the final copy. Note that the\n/// keyword tables below intentionally match the main crate verbatim: OpenAI's\n/// `insufficient_quota` arrives as HTTP 429, but retrying is pointless — it must\n/// classify as Billing, which is why billing keywords outrank the 429 status.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum VisionErrorKind {\n    /// API key invalid / unauthorized — retrying is pointless\n    Auth,\n    /// Out of balance / quota exhausted — retrying is pointless\n    Billing,\n    /// Rate limited / overloaded — retrying later is meaningful\n    RateLimit,\n    /// Image too large / format rejected\n    ImageTooLarge,\n    /// Anything else (network fault, unknown, empty body, …)\n    Other,\n}\n\n/// Billing keywords. Take precedence over HTTP 429 (see enum docs).\nconst BILLING_KEYWORDS: &[&str] = &[\n    \"余额不足\",\n    \"余额\",\n    \"充值\",\n    \"资源包\",\n    \"欠费\",\n    \"配额已用尽\",\n    \"配额耗尽\",\n    \"insufficient_quota\",\n    \"insufficient balance\",\n    \"exceeded your current quota\",\n    \"quota exceeded\",\n    \"billing\",\n    \"balance\",\n];\n\n/// Auth keywords.\nconst AUTH_KEYWORDS: &[&str] = &[\n    \"invalid api key\",\n    \"incorrect api key\",\n    \"api key not valid\",\n    \"invalid_api_key\",\n    \"unauthorized\",\n    \"authentication\",\n    \"鉴权失败\",\n    \"密钥无效\",\n    \"无效的密钥\",\n    \"密钥错误\",\n    \"令牌无效\",\n    \"access denied\",\n];\n\n/// Rate-limit keywords.\nconst RATE_LIMIT_KEYWORDS: &[&str] = &[\n    \"rate limit\",\n    \"ratelimit\",\n    \"too many requests\",\n    \"请求过于频繁\",\n    \"限流\",\n    \"触发频率限制\",\n    \"requests per min\",\n];\n\n/// Image-too-large keywords.\nconst IMAGE_TOO_LARGE_KEYWORDS: &[&str] = &[\n    \"image too large\",\n    \"图片过大\",\n    \"图片太大\",\n    \"payload too large\",\n    \"request entity too large\",\n    \"file too large\",\n    \"max image size\",\n    \"image size exceeds\",\n];\n\nfn body_contains(body_lower: &str, keywords: &[&str]) -> bool {\n    keywords.iter().any(|k| body_lower.contains(k))\n}\n\n/// Classify a vision API failure from HTTP status + body (pure function).\n///\n/// Match order = semantic priority:\n/// 1. billing keywords (429 + insufficient_quota is billing, NOT rate limit)\n/// 2. HTTP 401/403 → auth\n/// 3. auth keywords\n/// 4. HTTP 429 / rate-limit keywords\n/// 5. HTTP 413 / image-too-large keywords\n/// 6. other\npub fn classify_vision_error(status: Option<u16>, body: &str) -> VisionErrorKind {\n    let body_lower = body.to_lowercase();\n    if body_contains(&body_lower, BILLING_KEYWORDS) {\n        return VisionErrorKind::Billing;\n    }\n    if matches!(status, Some(401) | Some(403)) {\n        return VisionErrorKind::Auth;\n    }\n    if body_contains(&body_lower, AUTH_KEYWORDS) {\n        return VisionErrorKind::Auth;\n    }\n    if status == Some(429) || body_contains(&body_lower, RATE_LIMIT_KEYWORDS) {\n        return VisionErrorKind::RateLimit;\n    }\n    if status == Some(413) || body_contains(&body_lower, IMAGE_TOO_LARGE_KEYWORDS) {\n        return VisionErrorKind::ImageTooLarge;\n    }\n    VisionErrorKind::Other\n}\n\n/// Discriminator phrases embedded by [`format_vision_error`] — shared with\n/// [`classify_vision_error_text`] so the format → classify round trip is stable.\n///\n/// The phrase is what any downstream banner/classifier keys on; raw error bodies\n/// carrying quota/balance wording inside rate-limit/other copy cannot hijack the\n/// classification because the phrase outranks keyword matching.\nconst TEMPLATE_PHRASE_AUTH: &str = \"API 密钥无效或未授权\";\nconst TEMPLATE_PHRASE_BILLING: &str = \"账户余额不足或配额已用尽\";\nconst TEMPLATE_PHRASE_RATE_LIMIT: &str = \"请求被限流\";\nconst TEMPLATE_PHRASE_IMAGE_TOO_LARGE: &str = \"图片过大或格式不被接受\";\n\n/// Classify the FINAL single-layer error text (downstream tooling keys on the\n/// discriminator phrase first, then falls back to [`classify_vision_error`]).\npub fn classify_vision_error_text(text: &str) -> VisionErrorKind {\n    if text.contains(TEMPLATE_PHRASE_AUTH) {\n        return VisionErrorKind::Auth;\n    }\n    if text.contains(TEMPLATE_PHRASE_BILLING) {\n        return VisionErrorKind::Billing;\n    }\n    if text.contains(TEMPLATE_PHRASE_RATE_LIMIT) {\n        return VisionErrorKind::RateLimit;\n    }\n    if text.contains(TEMPLATE_PHRASE_IMAGE_TOO_LARGE) {\n        return VisionErrorKind::ImageTooLarge;\n    }\n    classify_vision_error(None, text)\n}\n\n/// Assemble the final single-layer error copy: one sentence carrying\n/// [provider+model] + [failure class] + [way out]. The returned string is the\n/// final text — callers must not prepend anything (it flows straight into the\n/// calling Agent's context, so it must be complete and truthful).\npub fn format_vision_error(\n    provider_label: &str,\n    model: &str,\n    status: Option<u16>,\n    raw_detail: &str,\n) -> String {\n    let kind = classify_vision_error(status, raw_detail);\n    let who = format!(\"视觉模型 {model}（{provider_label}）\");\n    let detail = raw_detail.trim();\n    let detail = if detail.is_empty() {\n        match status {\n            Some(s) => format!(\"HTTP {s}\"),\n            None => \"无详细信息\".to_string(),\n        }\n    } else {\n        match status {\n            Some(s) => format!(\"HTTP {s}：{detail}\"),\n            None => detail.to_string(),\n        }\n    };\n    match kind {\n        VisionErrorKind::Auth => format!(\n            \"图像理解调用失败（{who}）：{TEMPLATE_PHRASE_AUTH}。{detail}。\\\n             出路：检查 NUPHUS_MCP_VISION_API_KEY 是否有效、是否配到了正确的服务商，修复后重试。\"\n        ),\n        VisionErrorKind::Billing => format!(\n            \"图像理解调用失败（{who}）：{TEMPLATE_PHRASE_BILLING}。{detail}。\\\n             出路：到该服务商控制台充值或购买资源包后重试；\\\n             修复前图片理解类操作将持续失败，请如实告知用户，不要推测图像内容。\"\n        ),\n        VisionErrorKind::RateLimit => format!(\n            \"图像理解调用失败（{who}）：{TEMPLATE_PHRASE_RATE_LIMIT}。{detail}。\\\n             出路：瞬时限制，稍等数十秒重试即可，无需改配置。\"\n        ),\n        VisionErrorKind::ImageTooLarge => format!(\n            \"图像理解调用失败（{who}）：{TEMPLATE_PHRASE_IMAGE_TOO_LARGE}。{detail}。\\\n             出路：压缩或裁剪图片后重试。\"\n        ),\n        VisionErrorKind::Other => format!(\n            \"图像理解调用失败（{who}）。{detail}。\\\n             出路：可稍后重试；若持续失败请检查 NUPHUS_MCP_VISION_BASE_URL/MODEL 配置与服务商状态。\"\n        ),\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n    use std::collections::HashMap;\n\n    // ---- Failure classification (format → classify round trip) ----\n\n    #[test]\n    fn case).\n        assert_eq!(\n            classify_vision_error(Some(429), \"账户余额不足，请充值后重试\"),\n            VisionErrorKind::Billing\n        );\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn status_codes_map_to_kinds() {\n        assert_eq!(classify_vision_error(Some(401), \"\"), VisionErrorKind::Auth);\n        assert_eq!(classify_vision_error(Some(403), \"\"), VisionErrorKind::Auth);\n        assert_eq!(\n            classify_vision_error(Some(429), \"too many requests\"),\n            VisionErrorKind::RateLimit\n        );\n        assert_eq!(\n            classify_vision_error(Some(413), \"request entity too large\"),\n            VisionErrorKind::ImageTooLarge\n        );\n        assert_eq!(\n            classify_vision_error(Some(500), \"internal server error\"),\n            VisionErrorKind::Other\n        );\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn format_classify_round_trip_is_hijack_proof() {\n        // Each kind's formatted copy must classify back to the same kind even\n        // when the embedded raw body carries a DIFFERENT kind's keywords.\n        for (status, body) in [\n            (Some(401), \"unauthorized\"),\n            (Some(429), \"insufficient_quota\"),\n            (Some(429), \"rate limit exceeded, retry after 30s\"),\n            (Some(413), \"image too large\"),\n            (Some(500), \"upstream connect error\"),\n        ] {\n            let text = format_vision_error(\"openai\", \"test-model\", status, body);\n            assert_eq!(\n                classify_vision_error_text(&text),\n                classify_vision_error(status, body),\n                \"round trip failed for {status:?} {body}: {text}\"\n            );\n        }\n        // Hostile case: a rate-limit body containing quota wording inside the\n        // raw detail must still classify as RateLimit via the phrase.\n        let hostile = format_vision_error(\n            \"openai\",\n            \"m\",\n );\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn error_copy_carries_model_and_way_out() {\n        let text = format_vision_error(\"openai\", \"gpt-4o-mini\", Some(401), \"invalid api key\");\n        assert!(text.contains(\"gpt-4o-mini\"), \"{text}\");\n        assert!(text.contains(\"openai\"), \"{text}\");\n        assert!(text.contains(\"NUPHUS_MCP_VISION_API_KEY\"), \"{text}\");\n    }\n\n    /// Env var mutations are global within the test process; serialize to avoid parallel tests polluting each other.\n    fn env_lock() -> std::sync::MutexGuard<'static, ()> {\n        crate::test_support::ENV_LOCK\n            .lock()\n            .unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner())\n    }\n\n    const VARS: [&str; 5] = [\n        \"NUPHUS_MCP_VISION_API_KEY\",\n        \"NUPHUS_MCP_VISION_BASE_URL\",\n        \"NUPHUS_MCP_VISION_MODEL\",\n        \"NUPHUS_MCP_VISION_PROVIDER\",\n        \"NUPHUS_MCP_VISION_MAX_TOKENS\",\n    ];\n\n    /// Saves and clears the vision vars; restores them when the test ends.\n    struct EnvGuard {\n        saved: Vec<(String, Option<String>)>,\n    }\n    impl EnvGuard {\n        fn clear() -> Self {\n            let saved = VARS\n
